extracted.name: Bellini
extracted.description: Learn how to make a bellini! This classic sparkling cocktail is fruity, refreshing, and perfect for brunch. It's easy to make with 2 ingredients: peaches and prosecco.
ingredient_lines: 1½ pounds ripe peaches* (about 4, peeled, pitted, and sliced)
instruction_lines: Make the peach puree. Puree peaches in a blender until smooth.
Make each cocktail. Pour 2 ounces (¼ cup) peach puree into a champagne flute and top with prosecco. Stir gently to combine. Garnish with a peach slice and a sprig of fresh mint.
